local_measurement.scope: local file reconciliation only; no DB, broker, secrets, logs or live process queries
local_measurement.matching_limit: Position ledger has no position/order identity; symbol + entry date must be unique, additionally checked entry notional, exit date, quantity, PnL. Shared engine source; not independent broker confirmation.

quality_label_semantics.recovery_ord_tmd: broker order time, not asserted execution time

precalculation_definition.window_reason: source-timing validation around recent entries, not selected for performance
precalculation_definition.ex_sector_proxy: 005930/000660 union same-apply-date KODEX semiconductor ETF 2ETF07 equity basket
precalculation_definition.formula: same-day applicable PDF evaluated at previous close; prior value weights multiplied by next applicable PDF per-share valuation price relative; retained equity weights renormalized daily

limitations: PDF creation/redemption basket is not official index or audited actual holdings.
Corporate actions for all underlying stocks not independently reconciled.
Price-return proxy excludes dividends, cash, futures, financing, costs and real implementation.
Only five close-to-close intervals; not annual attribution or engine profitability proof.
No private account data sent to public endpoints.
No constituent-symbol changes in this window, but quantity changes in five intervals: [5, 0, 0, 84, 0].
